text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion has invited me to a tea
party she's
hosting to deepen her
connection to the other
Tracen students.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well. I'm honored to have
been invited.
Delicious tea, a chat with
friends... It's a truly
productive event,
wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
On that note, I've prepared a concoction
that can
make the party even more
delightful! What do
you say? Interested?
I know you are!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm not taking that crap! I can't believe
you... This
thing just started, and you're
already offering
weird things to people.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's wrong, Cafe? Is there
something
interesting about that wall?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...No. It's... nothing important.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Just... There's someone I've never seen
before...
standing over there...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I've heard your power of perception is incredible, Cafe. How splendid! What do you see?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Could it be a fairy of some sort? A
Japanese
fairy? Like a zashiki-warashi?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It doesn't have... that kind of aura...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Then perhaps a ghost? I might have met one in my castle before!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, care to include me in this juicy
little
conversation? I'm also interested in
subjects that
have yet to be proved with
science!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... How can you all get so excited
about
something so dubio—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fwoosh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: GAH! The hell was that?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that was just my tail. That was quite a reaction, though, Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Why you...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, how wonderful! If you're scared,
that means
some part of you believes!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Who're you callin' scared?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, don't get too mad at me! I'm just
happy
that you believe in the same
things as the rest of
us. ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tch.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Phew! Let's take a short break!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yes! I was just doing a little
thinking... I'm sure
my past self would be
shocked to see me right
now.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Sitting around with my friends and
laughing until
our sides ache...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I always used to sit around and imagine
what kind
of things I'd discuss with
people my age.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
But now it's happening right before my
eyes, and
it's beyond anything I could
have imagined!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So of course I'm having a great time.
How could I
not be? Not to mention that
all the Umamusume
here are so unique
and exciting!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By interacting with Umamusume her age,
Fine
motion is surely learning many new
things. It
seems her study abroad has
truly been
worthwhile.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I am a little worn out, but
there's a
certain joy in that fatigue, isn't
there? Time for
round two of tea party
time!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Well, my adaptability has always
been
one of my strong points, right?

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text:
During our inspection, your curiosity led
to us
visiting every related
establishment. We traveled
halfway
across the country in a day.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! We had tea with
everyone
everywhere we went. I barely
even had room left
for dinner...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wait! Now that I think about it, I didn't
prepare
any Irish tea for this party.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
All right! ♪ Sounds like a good excuse
to head to
that specialty shop the next
town over!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tap, tap.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: ...Godspeed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With "that specialty shop in the next
town" as my
only hint, I hype myself up
and chase after Fine
Motion.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Right! I have an inexhaustible supply of
stamina
when I'm having f—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey! What's all this smoke?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, ahaha! It seems the effects of
my
concoction manifested quicker than I
thought!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You are... the worst... Cough!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I wonder what's going on. I'm going
ahead,
Trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion runs off, eyes brimming with

excitement. It doesn't seem like she'll be
running
out of energy anytime soon...
